 Kyrie Irving Injury: Iffy to play Saturday
 Written by RotoWire Staff 
 Published on October 24, 2026 
 Irving (knee) is listed as questionable for Saturday's game against San Antonio.
 Irving may sit out the second leg of this back-to-back set due to left knee injury management. If the star floor general is held out of Saturday's contest, Marcus Sasser and Sergio de Larrea would be candidates for increased minutes. Naji Marshall could also see increased playmaking duties if Irving joins Cooper Flagg (shoulder) on the inactive list.
